title: Psalm 113
opening_line: Praise GOD: ye servants of the LORD,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Praise GOD: ye servants of the LORD,
text.normalized: Praise GOD: ye servants of the LORD,
text.reading: Praise GOD: ye servants of the LORD,

text.diplomatic: O praise, the LORD’s name praise.
text.normalized: O praise, the LORD’s name praise.
text.reading: O praise, the LORD’s name praise.

text.diplomatic: Yea, blessèd be the name of GOD
text.normalized: Yea, blessèd be the name of GOD
text.reading: Yea, blessèd be the name of GOD

text.diplomatic: from this time forth always.
text.normalized: From this time forth always.
text.reading: from this time forth always.

text.diplomatic: From rising sun to where it sets,
text.normalized: From rising sun to where it sets,
text.reading: From rising sun to where it sets,

text.diplomatic: GOD’s name is to be praised.
text.normalized: GOD’s name is to be praised.
text.reading: GOD’s name is to be praised.

text.diplomatic: Above all nations GOD is high,
text.normalized: Above all nations GOD is high,
text.reading: Above all nations GOD is high,

text.diplomatic: ’bove heav’ns his glory raised.
text.normalized: ’Bove heav’ns his glory raised.
text.reading: ’bove heav’ns his glory raised.

text.diplomatic: Unto the LORD our God that dwells
text.normalized: Unto the LORD our God that dwells
text.reading: Unto the LORD our God that dwells

text.diplomatic: on high, who can compare?
text.normalized: On high, who can compare?
text.reading: on high, who can compare?

text.diplomatic: Himself that humbleth things to see
text.normalized: Himself that humbleth things to see
text.reading: Himself that humbleth things to see

text.diplomatic: in heav’n and earth that are.
text.normalized: In heav’n and earth that are.
text.reading: in heav’n and earth that are.

text.diplomatic: He from the dust doth raise the poor,
text.normalized: He from the dust doth raise the poor,
text.reading: He from the dust doth raise the poor,

text.diplomatic: that very low doth lie;
text.normalized: That very low doth lie;
text.reading: that very low doth lie;

text.diplomatic: And from the dunghill lifts the man
text.normalized: And from the dunghill lifts the man
text.reading: And from the dunghill lifts the man

text.diplomatic: oppressed with poverty;
text.normalized: Oppressed with poverty;
text.reading: oppressed with poverty;

text.diplomatic: That he may highly him advance,
text.normalized: That he may highly him advance,
text.reading: That he may highly him advance,

text.diplomatic: and with the princes set;
text.normalized: And with the princes set;
text.reading: and with the princes set;

text.diplomatic: With those that of his people are
text.normalized: With those that of his people are
text.reading: With those that of his people are

text.diplomatic: the chief, ev’n princes great.
text.normalized: The chief, ev’n princes great.
text.reading: the chief, ev’n princes great.

text.diplomatic: The barren woman house to keep
text.normalized: The barren woman house to keep
text.reading: The barren woman house to keep

text.diplomatic: he maketh, and to be
text.normalized: He maketh, and to be
text.reading: he maketh, and to be

text.diplomatic: Of sons a mother full of joy.
text.normalized: Of sons a mother full of joy.
text.reading: Of sons a mother full of joy.

text.diplomatic: Praise to the LORD give ye.
text.normalized: Praise to the LORD give ye.
text.reading: Praise to the LORD give ye.
